notes: Special purpose vehicles that hold AI data centers or GPUs and carry the debt that paid for them, keeping it off the tenant's balance sheet. Amounts are USD billions as reported; null = undisclosed. status: closed (financing completed), raising (in market), reported (press reports, terms unconfirmed). 'stress' records the latest reported secondary price of the SPV's loans or bonds, in cents on the dollar (100 = par). Reviewed weekly with data/ai-deals.json.

spvs.name: Beignet Investor LLC
spvs.terms: Meta leases all facilities on an initial four-year term with extension options; Meta's residual value guarantee covers the first 16 years if a lease isn't renewed or is terminated

stress.note: Hyperion bonds (6.581% notes due 2049) fell to a record low near 91 cents

events.text: PIMCO-issued investment-grade bonds ($27B) backed by project assets; Blue Owl ~$7B equity for 80% of the JV
Bonds hit a record low near 91 cents on the dollar

spvs.name: Sopaipilla Investor LLC (Meta El Paso)
spvs.terms: Hyperion-style structure: senior secured notes issued by a vehicle 80% owned by BlackRock's GIP and HPS; Meta keeps 20% and is developer, operator and sole tenant. Priced at higher yields than Hyperion's 2025 deal. JPMorgan and Morgan Stanley arranged the bond sale

events.text: Over $13B package led by Morgan Stanley and JPMorgan, reported as Meta's CDS hit a record
$12.3B of senior secured notes launched; S&P preliminary A+, Fitch expected AA-
Priced at $12.5B, at higher yields than a comparable deal last year (WSJ)

spvs.terms: Two term loans ($23B and $15B), four-year maturities with two one-year extensions

spvs.terms: SPV buys Nvidia GPUs and leases them to xAI for five years; GPUs are the collateral; Nvidia up to $2B of the equity

spvs.name: CoreWeave DDTL 5.0

spvs.name: Lambda term loan B vehicle

spvs.terms: Asset-backed SPV funding GPUs for an investment-grade customer; fully amortizing, matures Dec 31, 2030; issued at 99.5

spvs.name: Volta Infrastructure GPU loan
spvs.project: Tydal, Norway (121 MW, leased from Bitdeer)
spvs.terms: $1.3B first-lien term loan C plus a ~$3.7B term loan backed by GPUs, six years; priced at SOFR + 6.50% and 95 cents (borrowing cost above 11%), below the 97–98 cents marketed; no corporate guarantee. JPMorgan and Goldman underwrote only the $1.3B term loan C; the GPU loan (about 36,000 Nvidia GPUs) was sold best-efforts. Two-year non-call and a rate step-down if Anthropic gets an investment-grade rating. Funds GPUs and a letter of credit for the data-center lease. Anthropic has a reported six-year, ~$10B compute contract at the site

events.text: JPMorgan begins sounding out lenders for about $5B

Priced at 95 cents and SOFR + 6.50%, the wide end of talk, with borrowing costs above 11%; the GPU tranche finished at about $3.7B. Closing/allocation not yet reported

spvs.name: SharonAI GPU-backed facility
spvs.project: Australia (first of several financings toward 68,000+ Nvidia GPUs by mid-2027)
spvs.terms: Senior secured facility through an SPV, backed by GPUs and their cash flows; 9.95% fixed rate before fees; SharonAI's first committed SPV debt facility. SharonAI (NASDAQ: SHAZ) has a June 2026 agreement with Nvidia for a 72 MW AI factory of up to 40,000 GB300 GPUs with revenue sharing and credit support

events.text: US$356M GPU-backed facility signed; Goldman Sachs among lenders (reported)
Terms reported: 9.95% fixed rate before fees; lenders include Goldman Sachs, Australian and Asian investors and private credit funds

spvs.name: Anthropic TPU lease financing (Broadcom-backed)
spvs.project: Google TPU hardware leased to Anthropic under five-year master equipment leases
spvs.terms: SPV buys the chips and leases them to Anthropic; $42B Class A senior secured tranche (banks) with a partial residual value guarantee from Broadcom (A-), and an $18B Class B junior tranche led by Blackstone ($9B of its own money). Covers roughly half of the $125.2B five-year TPU lease; payments start on delivery. Separate from Broadcom's up-to-$42B convertible note facility to Anthropic

events.text: Bloomberg: banks begin syndicating the $60B package; Blackstone leads the $18B junior tranche

spvs.name: SpaceX GPU master finance lease (Apollo)
spvs.project: GPU pods for SpaceX/xAI data centers
spvs.terms: Apollo-managed lessor buys GPU pods and leases them to SpaceX in tranches of about five to five and a quarter years; quarterly rent of 1/20 of financed cost plus a fixed rate set at pricing; ~$40B aggregate principal; expected to close before year-end, with leases starting in H1 2027 as GPUs are delivered. FT reported the package as ~$30B of investment-grade bonds plus ~$10B of loans

events.text: FT: SpaceX seeks ~$40B led by Apollo (~$10B bank loans, ~$30B investment-grade debt) to buy Nvidia chips; PIMCO among lenders in talks
SpaceX signs a binding commitment letter for a ~$40B master finance lease with an Apollo-managed lessor (8-K filed Oct 26)

spvs.name: Nebius bridge facility (Citi)
spvs.terms: Corporate-level senior secured 364-day bridge term loan (not an SPV), secured by substantially all assets of Nebius Group N.V., Nebius Inc. and Nebius B.V.; matures Oct 16, 2027; minimum liquidity covenant; prepayable without penalty

events.text: $3.5B bridge facility signed with Citi (announced Oct 22 in a 6-K)
